subject.title: feat: add publisher feed query and delta state

question: Should ClawHub adopt the RFC 0009 publisher query/delta contract as a permanent stored API foundation once the snapshot and signing dependencies are separated?
rationale: The PR creates permanent history tables and a cross-repository protocol contract; tests can validate mechanics but cannot decide whether that long-lived product and storage boundary is intended.

options.title: Sponsor the staged contract
options.body: Approve the direction, require the parent PR to land first, then review a rebased delta-only branch with real Convex upgrade and scale proof.

options.title: Narrow the storage layer
options.body: Accept only the minimum revision state needed by the snapshot API and defer append-only deltas until a signed consumer is ready.

options.title: Pause the feed track
options.body: Hold this branch and its child until maintainers confirm the end-to-end discovery and signing roadmap.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the staged contract
recommendation.body: Approve the direction, require the parent PR to land first, then review a rebased delta-only branch with real Convex upgrade and scale proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick is the strongest available routing candidate from the parent feed review and related publisher-identity work.
